name: NOOP (dbAbstract fork)
subtitle: Personal fork builds — food log, strap-first calories.
description:
A private AltStore / SideStore source for a personal fork of NOOP, the independent open-source WHOOP companion. Points at this fork's rolling `testing-latest` release, so each CI testing build appears here as an update.

NOOP is not affiliated with WHOOP. It reads a strap you own, directly over Bluetooth, on your own device — no WHOOP app, no subscription, no cloud.

apps.name: NOOP (fork)
apps.subtitle: Personal fork build with the v0 food log.
apps.localizedDescription:
A personal fork build of NOOP. Adds an on-device food and macro log, a manual weigh-in, and an opt-in preference to show NOOP's own calorie estimate instead of Apple Health's.

Built by this fork's 'Testing build (fork)' workflow from the food-log branch. Unsigned — SideStore re-signs it with your own Apple ID on install.
